panels.name: Entrance Hall
panels.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original HEAVY.EARTH dungeon art panel for scan-import testing.
Create a SQUARE 2048 x 2048 pixel illustration, designed to print on an 8 x 8 inch art board. This is a flat scan of pen-and-ink dungeon map artwork, no physical board photographed in perspective.
Style: old-school tabletop RPG architectural ink drawing, fine black contours, sparse stone masonry, delicate crosshatching and scratchboard marks, white stone walking surfaces, predominantly solid black surrounding subterranean earth. Grayscale ONLY, neutral black/white/gray, no cream or colored tint. Clear legible cutaway walls, a few arches and fixtures, generous visible floors, no people or creatures.
Geometry: parallel orthographic 2:1 dimetric dungeon projection. Ground axes have slopes EXACTLY +0.5 and -0.5 (26.565 degrees above/below horizontal); vertical walls are vertical on the page. No vanishing points or perspective convergence. Fine floor diamond lattice should be 128 pixels wide x 64 pixels high at 2048 canvas, corresponding to 0.5 x 0.25 inch diamonds on an 8-inch board. All grid vertices follow x=64*(u-v), y=32*(u+v) from top-left origin. Use that floor-cell scale throughout. Map occupies the square page with one main chamber and branching corridors, not a single isolated tiny tile. Corridors follow the two ground axes and reach some canvas edges so this feels like a portion of a bigger dungeon.
Composition: page TOP stays up, see two interior rear wall faces with the front walls cut low for visibility. Avoid tall walls obscuring the walking grid. No large solid-white blank regions outside rooms: surround rooms/corridors with black earth and restrained scratch marks near boundaries. Keep broad white floors with only thin grid ink so thresholding can be tested.
No text, numbers, logos, legends, watermark, border, page furniture, compass, or decorative frame. Original layout; do not reproduce any existing commercial tile.
Panel subject: A ruined gatehouse entrance hall: broad rectangular flagstone chamber, two short rows of square stone piers, a stout arched gateway in the back wall, a small side guard alcove with an empty bench, diagonal corridors extending to the left and right page edges. Simple mostly open floor for the easiest import test.
